messages.content: The sky is blue because of how sunlight interacts with Earth's atmosphere. When sunlight enters the atmosphere, it collides with gas molecules, and these collisions scatter blue light much more than other colors because blue light has a shorter wavelength. This scattered blue light comes at us from all directions, which is why the whole sky appears blue rather than just the direction of the sun.
